scope: M1 outbound control-message bounds and resource publication. Functional evidence only, without a new performance or release claim.

implementation.perCall: Results and errors are checked and encoded before transport writes. Oversize/depth/node failures reject only that call; input delivery and cleanup are preserved without replaying effects. Error UTF-16 messages and dynamic diagnostics share the payload node budget; fixed envelope metadata remains representable.
implementation.allocationOwnership: Browsers, contexts and pages stay private until successful result validation and encoding. A rejected allocation receives bounded disposal. Page initialization refreshes its snapshot while holding the same lock that enables live events. Post-registration target-discovery failures also withdraw their browser.
implementation.globalFailure: An event or handshake that cannot fit produces a bounded global resource error and closes the stream. Real partial/failed writes remain fatal. No requested payload is silently truncated.
implementation.encoding: Bounded prepared replies enter the output queue once, avoiding a large result clone or a second serialization.
